How tall an action menu may grow before it scrolls. The host's --popover-max-height belongs to the file-preview card (its siblings are --popover-width 450px, --popover-height 400px and the --popover-pdf-* pair) and is 95vh, which is a ceiling for a floating preview rather than a size for a compact menu; see docs/decisions.md.

The detail panel's property gutter, wide enough for its longest fixed label ("Resulting display title") on one line at the host's property label size, capped at 40% of the panel body so a narrow panel keeps its values readable. `--metadata-label-width` (9em) wraps that label, so the host value does not fit this object.
How narrow the assignee input may get before its Assign-to-me button wraps under it instead; no host variable describes a minimum input width.

A card's side padding, named so the title's clearance for the hover cluster can subtract the inset the card has already applied. A nested card redeclares it, which is why one shared name is needed rather than each rule spelling its own padding.

One quick-action button and the gap beside it. A cluster of n buttons has n-1 gaps and a title keeps one hair of clearance past it, so n steps measure both; the reach is built from three, and a card that renders no "mark done" button reserves one step less.

How far the full hover-action cluster reaches in from a card's edge: its inset, its own padding and three action steps (each a button plus a hair, the last hair being the title's clearance). Every term is a token .folia-card-actions is built from, so it cannot drift from the thing it measures, and it grows with input-derived button widths so themed controls never cover a title. A title reserves this less its card's side padding, subtracted at the title rule, and one step less on a card with no "mark done" button.
A card fills the column body after both column borders and both body paddings; its drag overlay must subtract the same composite inset.

Compact actions follow input height with a grid reduction, but never shrink below the fixed minimum target size. At Obsidian's default --input-height of 30px the reduction would give 22px, so the floor binds and this token is 24px; the host arm only takes over above 32px. That is the floor doing its job, not a dead branch — the pointer-target minimum outranks the compact tier.
